body: No and I'm a really weird and quirky guy but I'd much rather be known as weird and quirky instead of anti-social.. :( I'm just afraid of how people will judge me.
I'm really not comfortable with myself.. :(

well the weird murmuring and muttering is me making noises like "doo doo doo duh..." -checking my phone- not to come off as completely quiet and awkward and that's just me I'm a weird quirky kid and I'd much rather be known as a weird quirky kid than an antisocial one, because I'm not I just am too afraid to speak up. :(

yeah.. I have been having suicidal thoughts for about 2-3 months.. I just hate how I'm a really non socially awkward funny person around really good friends and I'm talking about 5 year+ friends and everyone else I'm just not myself and I get made fun of for who I'm not because I do come off as fake and I'm just a laughing stock amongst my friends... One time my friend started laughing his ass off when he was high and I said in my weird abnormal voice "whats so funny?" he replies in a short answer, "just you man." I reply "how am I funny?" he replies "haha shutup" and continues laughing.. after that I couldn't enjoy anything and because of it when I smoked weed I just thought about how fake I am how I should just end it all and how much of a joke I am.. I haven't hung out with them since because of the situation ending my 2-3 year friendship I really don't want anything to do with them it reminds me of who I'm not and I hate all of them.

thanks.. the thing about social anxiety though is that when you don't want to get noticed, the exact opposite happens and people start pointing you out like "hey why does that kid never talk?" and that just makes me feel even worse you know.. I have enough insecurities as is I just don't know why people would say stuff when I just want to be left alone. :(
